workflows.title: Receipt/contract scan intake, rename, and tracker.csv logging
steps: Log row in tracker.csv and flag anomalies
workflows.trigger: A new scanned file (scan-0XXX.pdf) appears in /Users/<redacted>/Documents/Paperwork/Inbox
workflows.outcome: tracker.csv gains one row per processed scan with original_file, new_filename, date, amount, type and status (filed, duplicate, review needed, or missing date); renamed PDF is left alongside originals in the Inbox folder
variations: Receipts without a readable date are renamed UNKNOWN-DATE_Vendor_receipt.pdf and logged with notes 'missing date'
Amounts matching an existing date+amount are flagged status=duplicate with a note pointing at the original filename
Contracts use type=contract and derive the type label from a client list (seen for Northwind) rather than from the document itself
Amounts over 500 are flagged status='review needed' with note 'over 500'
limitations: Only one week of evidence (2026-10-13 to 2026-10-16) was available; multi-week recurrence of this exact job is unconfirmed
Source of the scanned files (which scanner/app produces scan-0XXX.pdf) was not observed
Only one captured day supports this candidate; repetition is not established.

workflows.title: File incoming project email attachments into matching project folder and acknowledge sender
steps: Open attachment email and review request
Save attachment into matching project folder
workflows.trigger: An email arrives from a northbeam.co colleague with a project document attached and a request to file it in the project folder
workflows.outcome: The attachment is saved into the correct existing Documents/Projects/<Name> folder and a brief acknowledgment reply is sent back to the sender confirming where it was filed
variations: Reply wording varies slightly ('Saved next to the brief. Thanks Alex' vs 'Thanks Priya, filed in the Beacon folder. Morgan') but always confirms filing location
Sender sometimes references a relative location ('same place as the brief') rather than naming the folder explicitly
limitations: Only 2 instances observed in a single week (Atlas 2026-10-16, Beacon 2026-10-15), both from the same sender domain (northbeam.co); no evidence found in prior weeks to confirm longe
Folder-creation-for-new-project path was not observed since both target folders already existed
No ordered capture example covers every step. These references do not establish one end-to-end occurrence.
